text: Precision 2D drafting and 3D modeling, with multiplayer editing and an AI agent that drafts, models, and renders alongside you. 2D drafting and 3D solid modeling in one fast, beautiful workspace, from a command line that takes the shortcuts you already know. Ask a question or describe an edit in plain words, and the agent works right in your drawing. One source of truth for every drawing. No emailed copies, no files checked out, no “final_v3.” Every edit is kept with who made it and when. Share a link and everyone works in the same file, so there's never a stale copy, and you can see who's working where. Maya Chen · 2m Can the bore go to Ø32 for the larger bearing? Alex Rivera · now Opening it up now. Every file keeps unlimited version history, so nothing is lost and any change can be traced back. Version history Rev A Alex · Yesterday, 16:42 Bolt pattern You · Today, 10:18 Rev B Alex · Today, 11:06 Current version You · Today, 11:32 Rev A Rev B A drawing set is only as good as its annotation. Dimensions, GD&T, leaders, text, and tables, on layouts with viewports at any scale that print exactly as they look. Open DWG and DXF with their layouts, blocks, and dimensions, and bring in Rhino, STEP, glTF, and SVG. Send drawings back as DWG, DXF, or PDF, and models as STL or OBJ. Performance 250,000+ entities in one file. Keep the whole model in one place instead of splitting it across files to keep your CAD responsive. 108 floors. 38,510 editable solids. Write commands in JavaScript on the same API our built-in commands use: inputs with snaps, live previews, options, and one undo step. Keep them in the file or share them with your team. Or describe the command and let the agent write it . import { BRep, Curve, Plane } from "aircad"; export const manifest = { name: "Torus", kind: "command", capabilities: ["document:read", "document:write"], inputs: { center: { type: "point", prompt: "Pick the center" }, radius: { type: "length", prompt: "Major radius" }, tube: { type: "length", prompt: "Tube radius" }, }, api: 1, }; export default async function main(cad) { const center = await cad.input.point("center"); // Draw the ring while the pointer moves. const ring = cad.display.show(); const radius = await cad.input.length("radius", { from: center, onChange: (r) => ring.set(Curve.circle(Plane.at(center), r)), }); const tube = await cad.input.length("tube"); return cad.doc.add(BRep.torus(Plane.at(center), radius, tube)); } import { BRep , Curve , Plane } from "aircad" ; export const manifest = { name : "Torus" , kind : "command" , capabilities : [ "document:read" , "document:write" ], inputs : { center : { type : "point" , prompt : "Pick the center" }, radius : { type : "length" , prompt : "Major radius" }, tube : { type : "length" , prompt : "Tube radius" }, }, api : 1 , }; export default async function main ( cad ) { const center = await cad . input . point ( "center" ); // Draw the ring while the pointer moves. const ring = cad . display . show (); const radius = await cad . input . length ( "radius" , { from : center , onChange : ( r ) => ring . set ( Curve . circle ( Plane . at ( center ), r )), }); const tube = await cad . input . length ( "tube" ); return cad . doc . add ( BRep . torus ( Plane . at ( center ), radius , tube )); } Saved Torus as a draft in the Scripts panel: asks for center, radius, tube Deep scripting API No matter how strange the problem, our scripting API has you covered.
